title: Workflow example: full analysis pipeline with clean, filter, group, sort, and summary
description: A five-step workflow covering the complete analysis cycle: remove missing values, filter to a relevant subset, aggregate by category, sort the result, and generate a natural-language summary. Use this as a template for complex queries that ask for cleaning, subsetting, aggregation, ranking, and explanation in a single request.
keywords: 清洗过滤聚合排序总结
example_query: 帮我清洗数据，只看今年的记录，按地区统计平均销售额，从高到低排，最后给我一个总结
planning_notes: Order matters: (1) remove_missing_values first to avoid NaN propagation, (2) filter to the relevant subset, (3) group_by for aggregation, (4) sort_values to rank results, (5) generate_summary always last. Do not put generate_summary before other steps. Adapt column names and filter values to match the actual dataset.
